answer: Admission auction: scarce identity slots go to the highest sealed bidder. Each epoch offers 100 slots. Bids lock for 3 epochs. A prism of competing bids pushes the clearing price up. Losers get refunds minus a 2% fee. Forged bids are burned after a 2-epoch challenge window. Honest agents pay once and keep the slot. A lantern audit trail publishes every bid, so bulk buyers cannot hide. At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 fake identities cost 60,000 units. Demand doubles, price doubles. An oasis of cheap slots never forms. Supply stays fixed.
